attributes.board_name: Alabama Board of Examiners in Marriage and Family Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: MFT association (national/state/local) training; NBCC-approved courses; programs of allied mental health associations or agencies (psychology, counseling, nursing, medical, social work); federal mental health agencies; regionally accredited colleges/universities; graduate courses (1 semester = 15 h); supervision by an Approved MFT Supervisor (max 10 h); independent study (max 10 h); AAMFT or NBCC pre-approved synchronous distance learning
rules.audit_note: The Board audits randomly selected licensees before renewal; keep documentation 2 years.
rules.notes: Of the 40 hours: at least 10 in clinical MFT workshops, 6 in diagnosis and treatment, 6 in professional issues and ethics. Distance learning must be synchronous. License valid to Dec 31; late renewal with $200 fine until Mar 1.
rules.rule_quote: (3) In order for an LMFT license to be renewed, the licensee must have completed a minimum of forty (40) contact hours of acceptable Continuing Education or Experience Units during the previous twenty-four (24) months.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same activity types as for LMFT (MFT associations, NBCC, allied mental health associations, accredited colleges, graduate courses, AAMFT/NBCC synchronous distance learning)
rules.notes: Of the 20 hours: at least 5 in clinical MFT workshops, 3 in diagnosis and treatment, 3 in professional issues and ethics. MFT Interns: 10 hours per 24 months (3 clinical MFT, 3 diagnosis/treatment, 3 ethics).
rules.rule_quote: (2) In order for an MFT Associate License to be renewed, the MFT Associate must have completed a minimum of twenty (20) contact hours of acceptable Continuing Education or Experience Units during the previous twenty-four months.
